# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 75 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Mich. 130, Shepherd of Hermas 75 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_075_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9, Part 2 — The Rock, the Gate, and the Tower

**75:1** In the middle of the plain he showed me an enormous white rock rising up from it. The rock was taller than the mountains and square-shaped — big enough to hold the whole world. It was ancient rock, and cut into it was a gate; but the gate looked newly made, because it was shining more brightly than the sun.

**75:2** Twelve virgins were standing around the gate. The four at the corners seemed more glorious than the rest — but all of them were glorious. Two stood at each corner, and other virgins stood along the sides of the gate on either side.

**75:3** I asked him: "What does this gate mean?" "It's the Son of God," he told me. "There is no other way into God's presence except through his Son."

**75:4** I watched as six young men came and stood by the gate, and then a vast crowd of men came to build a tower on the rock. The virgins standing around the gate kept urging the workers to build quickly.

**75:5** The six young men directed the workers to bring stones for the construction. The forty virgins carried stones from the gate area and handed them to the six young men, who received them and built.

**75:6** The stronger workers carried stones up from the plain; others fetched stones from a rocky, hilly area nearby and brought them for the building. The virgins carried them in from the plain, through the gate, and handed them directly to the tower builders.

**75:7** When bright stones cut from the plain were brought in, the workers who had carried them trimmed and shaped them, then handed them to the virgins, who carried them through the gate to the builders. Once set in place, the stones looked exactly as they had when freshly cut — they were so bright and gleaming that the joints were seamless.

---

*PNEUMA renders for contemporary clarity and accessibility, making the rock-gate-tower vision of Similitude 9 vivid and architecturally tangible.*
